question: What meditative union empowers this attraction of the desired woman?
premises: The practice involves meditation on the great desire-art.
It is performed as a yogic union.
The goddess praised by gods is addressed.
inference: Union through meditation on the great kāma-kalā empowers the attraction.
uncertainties: Exact technical sense of 'kāma-kalā' is tradition-specific.
plain_english: O goddess praised by the gods, this occurs through union with meditation on the great kāma-kalā.
